name: OXO Rapid Brewer Default

steps.label: Press / release
steps.detail: About 2 minutes in total. Dilute 1:2 or 1:3 with water or milk

notes: OXO's own hot recipe: 20g fine coffee (first fill line) to 160 mL hot water, about 2 minutes. The brewer only holds about 5 oz of water. Makes a concentrate; OXO suggests diluting it 1:2 or 1:3.
